title: Whole Carding and Spinning Workcorner
description: One static fibre preparation and spinning workcorner scene, zero new independent models. Three complete previously qualified originals retain all original geometry buffers, hierarchy, normals and opaque PBR materials: one open worktable carries one complete unequal-drum carder rotated as an entire unit by a quarter turn, while a separate complete treadle spinning wheel occupies the lower floor station to the right. Both full carder base rails have finite full underside contact on the actual tabletop; elevated crank and feed portions can overhang without being mistaken for unsupported feet. The entire worktable and spinning wheel feet seat on one scene-only floor. An open forward approach separates the higher carding station from the independent lower spinning station; this is not two floor looms or a dye vat beside cloth. No original submesh is extracted, resized, recoloured or counted as a new model. Static illustrative equipment, empty of new fibre stock: no fibre processing, moving belt or treadle, yarn production, operator fit, ergonomics, loading, stability or safety performance claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made and outside scope.
